entries.reason: "Correction could not be verified for Argus, Bayle, Countess, Grim Exe, Kallari, Maco, Phase, Scarlett, Terra" (all six ranks; Diamond+ also names Vital Essence, 1.16.4-review2-123). Eleven 1.16.4 packet corrections (1.16.4-24, -25, -27, -29, -40, -51, -60, -73, -review2-127, -128, -129) no longer find their `before` value because the Pred.gg 1.17.2 kit text (version 169, changed in the 29 Oct collection) differs from it. The differences are of three kinds: (1) the field at the corrected path now holds a different ability's value (Argus ability 2 cooldown reads 3.5 and ability 1 text is the orb; Countess ability 4 cooldown reads 11/10/9/8/7), which is an ability-order difference in the source, not a balance change; (2) Pred.gg's own wording of a value the official note already states (Kallari LMB and Terra ability 1 read "+75%" / "+40%" without the official "bonus"; Phase ability 1 lacks the official 1700u/2100u link-radius line; Maco ability 2 differs only by a stray "%"; Bayle passive lists per-level values in place of the official range; Maco passive is reworded); (3) source-only values no official note confirms (Scarlett LMB base damage and hero bonus, Grim.exe LMB scaling and damage type). Rewriting a correction's `before` to Pred.gg's new text would be a source edit, not official text, and the ability-order cases need a code-side path fix that a review may not make. The official articles in the bundle (1.17.2, 1.17 with Hotfix 1.17.1, and the new 1.18 article, not yet live) add nothing that settles these fields. Nothing in the review files changes. Unresolved and held with its queue evidence.
entries.limitation: Only official text may resolve it; holding it hides an identical notice until the notice text or any live official article changes (1.18 going live on 3 Nov will change the article set and re-queue it). The ability-order mismatch for Argus and Countess may need a code fix (path by ability index), which is outside a review. Pred.gg kit text is retained from 31 Oct (Pred.gg could not be refreshed on 1 Nov). No in-game test.
